blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers brewed with German technique and a full menu including appetizers, salads, burgers, sandwiches, entrees, and kids meals. The brewpub also offers daily specials and to-go beer packs. The atmosphere emphasizes hard work, respect for craft, honesty, and a Midwestern lifestyle.
extraNote: Daily specials with specific pricing and time limits, e.g. $3 mugs Monday 3-8 pm, $3 off wraps Wednesday 3-8 pm, pitchers $10 Thursday on patio, $3 pints Friday 3-6 pm, 50% off kids meals Saturday 11 am-4 pm, $7 special Sunday. · Old Nation Brewpub in Williamston, MI
